title: The Both Sides Of Me
overview: Renz Montecarlos a student gets bullied after coming out as Bisexual, AJ Garcia his best friend is there for him, but unfortunately his father is homophobic and everything seems bad until Renz became friends with nicer people.  Based off the Wattpad Story by PRNCSPLM also known as Chase Pulumbarit, who wrote and directed it with Lexie Vergel De Dios. Released in Select Theaters and digitally on YouTube.
